topic: Should we change our pricing for [product/plan], and if so, how?
description: Evaluate a proposed pricing change: impact on revenue, customer churn, competitive positioning, and go-to-market messaging.
investigationInstructions: Analyze current pricing tiers, customer distribution, and revenue per tier.
Research competitor pricing for comparable offerings.
Model revenue impact of proposed price changes (new vs. existing customers).
Assess churn risk: price sensitivity by segment, grandfathering options.
Evaluate competitive positioning after the change.
Plan customer communication and grandfathering strategy.
Define success metrics and review timeline.
evidenceRequirements: Current pricing tiers and customer counts per tier
Historical churn data by pricing tier
Customer LTV and CAC data by segment
expectedOutputStructure: Revenue impact model (best case, expected, worst case)
Success metrics and 30/60/90 day review checkpoints
